Kling Image 4.0 ranks #7 in Text to Image and #6 in Image Editing, behind only OpenAI and Microsoft AI models

It generates images up to 8K, and its 2K price is under a third of the price of every OpenAI model ranked above it. In Image Editing, it sits just behind GPT Image 2.5

Released November 17, Kling Image 4.0 is Kling AI's new model for text to image generation and image editing. It follows Kling Image 3.0
